summary: As of mid-2026, the LLM landscape is dominated by OpenAI's ChatGPT/GPT family with ~54-56% of global AI web traffic, but competition has intensified dramatically with Gemini surging to ~26-28% share and Claude reaching ~9% share. The market has bifurcated into proprietary API leaders (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and a thriving open-weight ecosystem led by Meta's Llama 4, DeepSeek, and Qwen, with 79% of developers now using open-source LLMs according to Mozilla/SlashData. Enterprise aggregator platforms like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex have become critical adoption multipliers, meaning models available across multiple clouds command far greater real-world usage than direct API statistics alone suggest.

models.name: GPT-5 / GPT-5.1
models.popularity_notes: ChatGPT commands 53.9-55.5% of global AI web traffic as of May-August 2026 (Similarweb), and OpenAI leads LLM API market share with GPT-5 and GPT-5.1 available across Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach.
strengths: Largest developer ecosystem and tooling support
Multi-step reasoning and conversational dialogue
Real-time interactions and tool use
Ubiquitous aggregator availability (Azure, AWS, Vertex)
Broad multimodal capabilities
Strong function calling and agentic workflows
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise AI applications, conversational agents, and developer productivity tools requiring broad ecosystem support

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Google Gemini holds 25.6-27.9% of global AI chatbot web traffic as of mid-2026 (Similarweb), with web visits surging ~450% year-over-year to 2.9 billion in May 2026, and native integration across Google Workspace, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Android gives it massive enterprise and consumer aggregator reach.
strengths: Industry-leading 1M token context window
Deep Google ecosystem integration (Workspace, Search, Android)
Strong multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, video
Native Vertex AI deployment for enterprises
Competitive long-document analysis
Fast improving benchmark trajectory
models.best_for: Long-context document processing, multimodal enterprise workflows, and organizations deeply integrated with Google Cloud infrastructure

models.name: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Claude holds 9.2-9.3% of global AI web traffic (Similarweb, May-August 2026) but commands 40% of enterprise API usage per Menlo Ventures 2025, with visits up 855% year-over-year; available on AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure, making it the enterprise API market leader by spend.
strengths: Leads enterprise API usage at 40% market share by spend
Top-ranked on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
Constitutional AI safety design preferred by regulated industries
Exceptional long-document comprehension and summarization
Strong coding and agentic task performance
Available across all major cloud aggregators
models.best_for: Enterprise applications requiring high reliability, safety guarantees, and complex reasoning, especially in regulated industries like finance, legal, and healthcare

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Meta's Llama family is the most downloaded open-weight model series on HuggingFace with billions of downloads cumulatively, Llama 4 is ranked among the top five LLMs of 2026 by multiple analyst sources, and its permissive license drives adoption across AWS Bedrock, Azure, Google Vertex AI, IBM watsonx, and Snowflake Cortex as well as self-hosted deployments.
strengths: Most widely downloaded open-weight model family globally
Permissive license enabling commercial self-hosting
Available on every major cloud aggregator platform
Strong general reasoning capabilities
Massive fine-tuning and community ecosystem
Zero-cost self-hosted deployment option
models.best_for: Organizations needing self-hosted or on-premise deployment, fine-tuned vertical models, and teams wanting to avoid vendor lock-in with strong general reasoning

models.name: DeepSeek-V3 / DeepSeek-V4
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek holds 4.1% of global AI chatbot web traffic (May 2026, Similarweb) and 24.4% of text API requests on OpenRouter as of September 21, 2026, with DeepSeek-V4-Pro ranked best for bug fixing, code generation, and reasoning on the Onyx Open LLM Leaderboard July 2026; available on AWS Bedrock and Azure.
strengths: 24.4% of OpenRouter API text requests — dominant among API aggregator users
State-of-the-art coding and bug-fixing capabilities
Exceptional cost efficiency relative to performance
Strong reasoning with Mixture-of-Experts architecture
Developed with significantly less compute than comparable Western models
Top-ranked open-weight model for code generation and reasoning
models.best_for: Cost-conscious developers and enterprises needing high-performance coding assistance, reasoning, and open-weight flexibility at a fraction of proprietary model costs

models.name: Grok-3 / Grok-4
models.popularity_notes: Grok holds 2.4% of global AI chatbot web traffic (May 2026, Similarweb) and is listed among the top five LLMs of 2026 by Exploding Topics and SEOVision; its integration with X (Twitter) provides a unique real-time web data advantage and access to hundreds of millions of X platform users.
strengths: Real-time information access via X platform integration
Strong performance on math, reasoning, and cyber benchmarks
Witty conversational style preferred for consumer use cases
Rapidly improving benchmark trajectory with Grok-4
Access to real-time social media data stream
Growing enterprise API availability
models.best_for: Applications requiring real-time information, social media analysis, and users on the X platform ecosystem needing current events awareness

models.name: Qwen3 / Qwen3-235B
models.popularity_notes: Qwen models are adopted by over 90,000 enterprises across consumer electronics, gaming, and other sectors per Shakudo research, ranked among the best open-weight alternatives of 2026 by SEOVision and Exploding Topics, with Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking exceeding 1 trillion parameters and supporting 119 languages.
strengths: 90,000+ enterprise deployments globally
Industry-leading multilingual support across 119 languages
Massive 1T+ parameter scale in flagship model
Strong open-weight performance rivaling proprietary models
Particularly strong in Asian language markets
Available for self-hosted deployment
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications, Asian market deployments, and organizations needing large-scale open-weight models with extensive enterprise support

models.name: Mistral Large 3 / Mixtral
models.popularity_notes: Mistral is ranked among the best open-source LLMs of 2026 for speed and efficiency by multiple sources including Kairntech and Dextralabs, with Mistral Large 3 listed on Exploding Topics' comprehensive LLM list and available on AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Google Vertex AI, driving significant European enterprise adoption.
strengths: Exceptional inference speed relative to model size
Strong performance-per-dollar ratio
Available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI
GDPR-compliant European-headquartered vendor
Mixture-of-Experts architecture for efficient deployment
Popular for latency-sensitive production applications
models.best_for: Latency-sensitive production deployments, European enterprises with data sovereignty requirements, and teams needing fast inference at lower cost

models.name: Microsoft Copilot (GPT-5 powered)
models.popularity_notes: Microsoft Copilot holds 1.3% of global AI chatbot web traffic (May 2026, Similarweb) but its true adoption is vastly larger through deep integration into Microsoft 365, GitHub, Azure, and Windows reaching hundreds of millions of enterprise seats; Azure OpenAI Service is the largest enterprise aggregator for OpenAI models.
strengths: Embedded in Microsoft 365 reaching 400M+ enterprise seats
GitHub Copilot dominates developer coding assistance market
Azure OpenAI Service is the largest enterprise LLM aggregator
Deep integration with Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint
Enterprise security and compliance built-in
Familiar interface reduces enterprise adoption friction
models.best_for: Microsoft-centric enterprise environments, developer coding assistance via GitHub Copilot, and organizations standardized on Microsoft 365 and Azure infrastructure

models.name: Perplexity AI (Sonar)
models.popularity_notes: Perplexity holds 1.3% of global AI chatbot web traffic (May 2026, Similarweb) with strong developer API adoption through its Sonar models on OpenRouter and direct API, carving out a distinct niche as the leading AI-native search and retrieval-augmented generation platform with rapidly growing enterprise adoption.
strengths: Real-time web search integrated directly into every response
Strong citation and source attribution
Leading AI-native search experience
Sonar API popular on OpenRouter for RAG applications
Fast response times for search-augmented queries
Growing enterprise API adoption for research workflows
models.best_for: Research-intensive workflows, real-time information retrieval, RAG pipelines requiring live web data, and applications where cited sources are essential
